name: one-memory-critic-and-selective-anchor-investigation
actor_start: runs/geometric-retained/latest.pt; mechanically strongest preserved legal V13, not verified superior to original baseline
critic_diagnostic: 40 independent frozen-policy trajectories, 4096 decisions each. 24 train, 16 held out by complete seed pairs; first2048 labels use discounted Monte Carlo continuation plus common old-critic boundary bootstrap at4096. Memory is detached post-current-observation actor GRU output. Compare obs64, memory64 and approximately parameter-matched obs128/56, three fitting seeds. No actor optimization.
critic_acceptance: At least10% mean heldout MSE reduction against observation-only and parameter-capacity control, wins in at least2/3 fitting seeds, paired-trajectory bootstrap95% MSE difference strictly below0 versus both controls. Reject otherwise.
time_rates: alternate60/120Hz by rollout; same original callback_dt observation; gamma/lambda exponent=ticks/2
memory_alignment: h_t after consuming x_t, paired with x_t and r_t; v_next from actor(x_next,h_t); freeze/detach collection memory for critic fitting. No actor gradient from value loss, no h reset on goals, new rollout starts h=None.
anchor: No all-state mode reference KL or old all-ball CE. Chase CE .01 only suitable grounded aligned approaches, steering MSE .1 on same mask; conditional reference steering KL .02 only if reference steer within.2 of independent target. Outside mask all anchor terms exactly zero. No runtime override.
approach_mask: ball present, own car grounded, ball below160UU, local-forward positive, abs(atan2(right,forward))<.65, distance300..2500UU, >1sec since either-agent contact. Privileged ground/contact only training masks, never actor inputs.
reward: unchanged current goal+10/-10, PBpotential .7signed goal-distance/.08car-ball distance, productive clipped signed delta-v term .08, nonproductive -.003, sustained stationary -.001*ticks/2. Each component individually logged; goal-reset PB accounted. No obsolete touch+2/goal20 reward.
opponents: frozen original V13, validated A, geometric V13 uniform seeded; no external assets or new opponents downloaded
screen_pass: ground>=9/12, kickoffs>=8/10, no >50% stationary-time or Neutral collapse, conservative >.5 match score vs starting geometric with at least5 completed wins; then120 unused-seed matches (40 per opponent). No extension or tuning if fails.
promotion: Independent full-match evidence, Windows acceptance and explicit user approval. Main/organizer access/submission prohibited without approval.
native_evidence: User reports validated A noticeably worse than original V13 in actual RLBot v5; qualitative only, formal scores/callback evidence incomplete.
critic_fallback: Memory rejected. Keep original observation-only critic architecture and previously preserved critic+Adam state: its heldout MSE6.045/EV.00034 exceeds all refits. Actor strictly starts geometric; failed anchored actor weights are not loaded. Four warm-fit epochs on fresh current-policy rollouts; no optimizer reset.
